All previous regression names remain and no ignore attributes were added. All original fixture bytes match selected hashes/lengths and retained preflight copies, with separate source identities and attribution preserved.

I independently read and hash-checked the owner's completed normal locked test receipt, compiler binding and full raw log: **136 xtask tests passed, including all 22 membership regressions; zero failures, ignores or filters**. Cargo reports a Fresh=false test artifact rooted in this worktree and the receipt binds unchanged Source/index/status across execution. The reviewer did not execute Cargo or mutate the shared cache.

The actual CLI, required repository Clippy/formatting, lead full-app validation, current full-workspace CI and integration guards remain separate completion gates. This verdict grants no Android Studio UI fidelity, startup/memory/large-project performance, compiled upstream membership, runtime-case or original behavioral parity credit. Runtime cases remain null and global census completion remains false. Prior failure reports remain intact.

The reviewer read hold is released.
